about: BioCLIP 2's image encoder for the device: four machines, each exporting the encoder and making its recipes (int8 per channel; unsigned int8 per channel and 4-bit block weights; 8-bit weights with float arithmetic and float16; int8 with the second MLP layer of each block in float arithmetic), each run through onnxruntime-web 1.30.0's WASM build on 320 test photos (every k-th test row of eval/alachua-2025). device_pub scores them against the original model's published vectors and the published server rows, and publishes the chosen int8 file in parts of at most 90,000,000 bytes to pub/model-bioclip2-l14.
